title: Cash Standing under Membership and Patronage Equity Set against an Arrears Settlement, Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
Where the board's allocation has been posted to a member's equity account under Membership and Patronage Equity, the cash portion of it is set against what is sought to settle the arrears on their crop input account, and how much follows whether cash has already been paid against that allocation.

**Clause.** Where an allocation has been posted to the member's equity account over the 12 statement months before the handling date and no cash payment against it stands on the equity ledger over those months, the share set against the amount sought is the whole of the cash portion — 100 percent. Where an allocation has been posted to the member's equity account over those months and a cash payment stands on the equity ledger over those months, the share set against the amount sought is 25 percent. In every other case no share of the cash portion is set against the amount sought on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

| Allocations posted over the 12 statement months | Cash payments standing on the equity ledger over those months | Share of the cash portion set against the amount sought |
| --- | --- | --- |
| one or more | none | 100 percent |
| one or more | one or more | 25 percent |
| none | either | No share is set against it |

The cash portion the share is taken on is the cash portion of the allocations posted to the member's equity account over those same 12 statement months, so an allocation posted outside the window carries nothing into the figure.
